credentials.title: Portal credentials
credentials.hint: Radal stores the password encrypted and never shows it again. The robot uses it only to log into the portal.
credentials.passwordKeep: Leave empty to keep the saved password
credentials.deleteBody: The robot will not be able to log into {{portal}} until you set them up again.
credentials.noPermission: Only a brokerage administrator can change the credentials.
credentials.notRequired: This portal does not ask for credentials.
credentials.upcomingHint: They are not connected to Radal yet; you will be able to save their credentials once they are.

comingSoon.subtitle: Quote directly on the insurers' portals without leaving Radal. Coming soon.
comingSoon.what: Radal will sign in to each insurer's portal with your credentials, fill in the quote with the account's data and bring the plans back into the Comparison.

will.fill: Fill in the portal's quote form with the data you already have on the account.
will.compare: Bring back each quoted plan normalised, ready to compare alongside the other quotes.
will.file: Store the PDF and the search details in the account's file.

comingSoon.whyFallback: The insurers' portals need each insurer's user and password to apply filters, and they are not configured yet.
comingSoon.credentialsNote: Once enabled, each brokerage will register its own credentials; Radal never displays them.
comingSoon.alt: Request the quote from the insurer and upload the PDF in the account's Comparison: Radal reads and normalises it just the same.
comingSoon.altCase: Request the quote from the insurer and upload the PDF in this account's Comparison: Radal reads and normalises it just the same.
